The taxonomy explicitly states color depends on composition (including limestone/sandstone). The image shows a white/beige limestone cliff, which is a valid instance of the class. Marking this as 'false' implies a defect, whereas it is simply a variation within the class definition. I disagree with the 'false' verdict; it should be considered 'present' (valid variation) or at least not a negative factor for alignment. The other checkpoints are accurately assessed.
